description: Grim Chess chess-knowledge skill graph (DAG) from absolute zero to GM. See README.md in this folder.
lichessThemeKeysSource: https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/master/modules/puzzle/src/main/PuzzleTheme.scala (visible themes; hidden internal key checkFirst excluded), verified 2026-11-11

skills.name: Board coordinates
skills.summary: Names files a-h and ranks 1-8 and identifies any square by its coordinate from both White and Black perspectives.
skills.masteryCriteria: Names 20 random highlighted squares in <30s with >=95% accuracy from White view and from Black view
references: FIDE Laws of Chess 2023 Art. App. C

skills.name: Board orientation and initial position
skills.summary: Places the board light-square-on-the-right and sets up all 32 pieces correctly, queen on her own colour.
skills.masteryCriteria: Sets up the initial position from an empty board with no errors in 3/3 attempts in under 90s each

skills.name: Capturing pieces
skills.summary: Captures by moving onto an enemy-occupied square; pieces cannot capture their own side.
skills.masteryCriteria: Finds every available capture in 10 diagrams with 100% accuracy

skills.name: Check and the three ways to escape it
skills.summary: Recognises check and escapes by moving the king, capturing the checker, or interposing.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 15 check diagrams lists all legal replies with >=95% accuracy; never makes an illegal move leaving the king in check in 10 bot games

skills.name: Checkmate
skills.summary: Knows the goal of the game: the king is in check and has no legal escape.
skills.masteryCriteria: Classifies 20 positions as check / checkmate / neither with >=95% accuracy

skills.name: Relative piece values
skills.summary: Knows conventional values P1 N3 B3 R5 Q9 and uses them to judge trades.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=90% on 20 "which trade is good for you?" items using material count

skills.name: How the bishop moves
skills.summary: Bishop moves diagonally any distance and stays on one colour.
skills.masteryCriteria: Completes 10 bishop target drills with minimum moves, 100% legal; explains why a bishop never changes colour

skills.name: How the king moves
skills.summary: King moves one square in any direction and may never move into check; kings can never be adjacent.
skills.masteryCriteria: Identifies all legal king moves in 10 diagrams with 100% accuracy

skills.name: How the knight moves
skills.summary: Knight moves in an L-shape and jumps; always changes square colour.
skills.masteryCriteria: Completes the knight-tour-to-target drill (10 targets) with minimum moves in <3 min total, 100% legal

skills.name: How the pawn moves and captures
skills.summary: Pawn moves forward one (two from start), captures diagonally, never backward.
skills.masteryCriteria: Lists all legal pawn moves in 10 diagrams (incl. blocked pawns and double steps) with 100% accuracy

skills.name: How the queen moves
skills.summary: Queen combines rook and bishop movement.
skills.masteryCriteria: Completes 10 queen target drills with minimum moves, 100% legal

skills.name: How the rook moves
skills.summary: Rook moves any distance along ranks and files, cannot jump.
skills.masteryCriteria: Completes 10 rook maze/target drills with the minimum move count, 100% legal moves

skills.name: Pawn promotion
skills.summary: A pawn reaching the last rank becomes a queen, rook, bishop or knight of the player's choice.
skills.masteryCriteria: Promotes correctly in 10 drills including choosing a piece not previously captured; explains why a second queen is allowed

skills.name: Stalemate
skills.summary: No legal move and not in check is a draw.
skills.masteryCriteria: Classifies 20 positions as checkmate / stalemate / play-on with >=95% accuracy

skills.name: Capturing hanging pieces
skills.summary: Spots and captures undefended pieces; avoids leaving own pieces hanging.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 30 hangingPiece puzzles rated <800 with >=95% accuracy, median <15s

skills.name: Ladder mate with two heavy pieces
skills.summary: Mates with two rooks or queen+rook by alternating ranks.
skills.masteryCriteria: Mates with K+R+R v K from 5 random positions within 10 moves each, 0 stalemates

skills.name: Mate in one
skills.summary: Finds one-move checkmates.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 40 mateIn1 puzzles rated <900 with >=95% accuracy, median <15s

skills.name: Fool's and Scholar's mate (attack and defence)
skills.summary: Knows the fastest mates and how to defend f7/f2 against early queen attacks.
skills.masteryCriteria: Defends against Scholar's mate attempts in 5/5 bot games; demonstrates both mates

skills.name: Board vision: seeing all attacks
skills.summary: Instantly sees which squares each piece attacks and which pieces are defended.
skills.masteryCriteria: Counts attackers/defenders of a marked piece in 20 diagrams with >=95% accuracy, <10s each

skills.name: K+Q vs K checkmate
skills.summary: Mates with king and queen using the box/knight-distance method, checking that the defender always has a legal move (no stalemate).
skills.masteryCriteria: Mates vs engine from 5 random positions within 10 moves each with 0 stalemates

skills.name: Opening principle: fight for the centre
skills.summary: Occupies or controls e4/d4/e5/d5 in the first moves.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 10 opening positions picks a centre-fighting move among 4 options in >=90%

skills.name: Opening principle: develop pieces
skills.summary: Develops knights and bishops quickly, avoids moving pieces twice and early queen sorties.
skills.masteryCriteria: Develops all minor pieces by move 8 in 5/5 games vs bot ~600

skills.name: Sportsmanship and playing on
skills.summary: Shakes hands, plays to the end and keeps fighting in bad positions (beginner opponents often fail to convert).
skills.masteryCriteria: Completes 10 bot games to a result without abandoning and saves >=2 of 10 lost (-3) positions vs bot ~800

skills.name: Castling and its conditions
skills.summary: Castles kingside and queenside, knows all permanent and temporary conditions, and spots castling with a threat.
skills.masteryCriteria: Judges legality of castling in 20 diagrams (attacked squares, moved king/rook, pieces between, b1 attacked) with >=95% accuracy

skills.name: Dead position and insufficient material
skills.summary: Recognises positions where no sequence of legal moves can lead to mate (K v K, K+B v K, K+N v K, blocked chains).
skills.masteryCriteria: Classifies 20 material/position combos as dead / not dead with >=90% accuracy, including K+N+N v K (not dead)

skills.name: Repetition and move-count draws (3-fold, 5-fold, 50, 75)
skills.summary: Same position three times allows a claim, five times is automatic; 50 moves without capture or pawn move allows a claim, 75 is automatic.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=90% on 20 items on repetition (incl. castling/e.p. differences) and 50/75-move counting from move lists or FEN halfmove clocks

skills.name: En passant capture
skills.summary: Captures a pawn that has just double-stepped past, only on the immediately following move, and uses en passant tactically (line opening, discovered check, mate).
skills.masteryCriteria: Identifies whether en passant is legal in 20 diagrams with move history with >=95% accuracy

skills.name: Reading algebraic notation (SAN)
skills.summary: Reads SAN move lists including captures, checks, castling, promotion and disambiguation.
skills.masteryCriteria: Plays through a 20-move SAN game on a board with 0 errors in 2/2 attempts
references: FIDE Laws of Chess 2023 Art. App. C

skills.name: Writing algebraic notation
skills.summary: Records own and opponent moves correctly in SAN.
skills.masteryCriteria: Writes the SAN for 30 moves shown on a board with >=95% accuracy including disambiguation
references: FIDE Laws of Chess 2023 Art. 8.1, App. C

skills.name: Attacking f7/f2 in the opening
skills.summary: Exploits the weakness of f7/f2 defended only by the king.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 attackingF2F7 puzzles ~1100 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Counting attackers and defenders
skills.summary: Counts attackers vs defenders and evaluates multi-capture sequences (static exchange evaluation) including x-ray recaptures.
skills.masteryCriteria: Correctly judges 20 "can I win this piece?" positions and gives net material for 10 multi-piece exchanges with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Double attack
skills.summary: One move creates two threats at once.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 double-attack puzzles ~900 with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Knight forks
skills.summary: Uses knight forks including family forks with check.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 30 knight-fork puzzles ~1000 with >=90% accuracy, median <30s

skills.name: Pawn, queen and other forks
skills.summary: Pawn forks, queen forks with check, and rook, bishop and king forks.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 30 pawn/queen/rook/bishop/king fork puzzles ~1100 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Absolute pins
skills.summary: Pins a piece to the king so it cannot legally move.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 pin puzzles ~1000 with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Promotion tactics
skills.summary: Wins by promoting with tempo, deflecting blockers or using advanced pawns.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 promotion/advancedPawn puzzles ~1100 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Skewers
skills.summary: Attacks a valuable piece which must move and expose a piece behind it.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 skewer puzzles ~1000 with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Arabian mate
skills.summary: Rook and knight mate in the corner.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 12 arabianMate puzzles with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Back-rank and corridor mates
skills.summary: Mates a king trapped on its back rank or in a corridor by its own pieces; knows luft as defence.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 backRankMate puzzles ~1000 and 5 curated corridor mates with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Legal's mate
skills.summary: The pinned-knight queen sacrifice trap ending Bxf7+ and Nd5#.
skills.masteryCriteria: Plays the Legal trap from the start vs a scripted bot and explains why the pin is illusory; solves 5 Legal-type puzzles

skills.name: Defending against mate threats
skills.summary: Spots mating threats and parries with luft, interposition, or counter-threat.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 15 "opponent threatens mate" positions finds a saving move with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Mate in two
skills.summary: Finds forcing two-move mates, checks first.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 30 mateIn2 puzzles ~1100 with >=85% accuracy, median <60s

skills.name: Smothered mate and Philidor's legacy
skills.summary: Knight mates a king surrounded by its own pieces, including the Qg8+ Rxg8 Nf7# queen-sacrifice combination.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 15 smotheredMate puzzles ~1100 and 5 Philidor-legacy positions with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Supported queen mates (Damiano family)
skills.summary: Queen mates adjacent to the king, protected by another unit (Damiano, Damiano's bishop).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 supported-queen mate puzzles ~1000 with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Blunder check before moving
skills.summary: Before each move checks opponent's checks, captures and threats after the move ("real chess" vs "hope chess").
skills.masteryCriteria: Over 10 rated games (15+10) blunders (engine -3.0 or worse in one move) on fewer than 1 move per game on average

skills.name: Forcing moves first: checks, captures, threats
skills.summary: Searches checks, captures and threats for both sides before quiet moves.
skills.masteryCriteria: Lists all checks, captures and direct threats for both sides in 15 diagrams within 60s each, >=90% complete

skills.name: What does my opponent threaten?
skills.summary: After every opponent move asks what it attacks, threatens or leaves undefended.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 20 positions names the opponent's threat after the last move with >=90% accuracy; in 10 bot games loses no piece to a 1-move threat

skills.name: Piece activity, development and tempo
skills.summary: Places pieces on active, coordinated squares; understands tempo and that a development lead must be used; improves the worst-placed piece.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 15 positions picks the engine-top-3 piece-improving move in >=75% and scores >=85% on a 15-item tempo quiz

skills.name: K+R vs K checkmate
skills.summary: Mates with king and rook (box or opposition method).
skills.masteryCriteria: Mates vs engine from 5 random positions within 16 moves each with 0 stalemates

skills.name: K+P vs K basics
skills.summary: King in front of pawn; defender blocks the promotion square; stalemate defence.
skills.masteryCriteria: Draws as defender in 5/5 basic K+P v K positions vs engine

skills.name: Rule of the square
skills.summary: Decides instantly whether a king catches a passed pawn.
skills.masteryCriteria: Answers 20 "can the king catch it?" diagrams (incl. double-step cases) in <10s each with >=95% accuracy

skills.name: First Black repertoire (1...e5 and 1...d5)
skills.summary: Answers 1.e4 with 1...e5 and 1.d4 with 1...d5, with sound development plans.
skills.masteryCriteria: Reproduces 6 moves of chosen lines with 95% accuracy and reaches equality (engine within 0.7) in 4/5 bot games

skills.name: First White repertoire (1.e4, Italian)
skills.summary: Plays 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 with basic plans and knows replies to common Black defences.
skills.masteryCriteria: Reproduces the first 6 moves of the chosen lines with 95% accuracy in opening-drill and reaches a playable middlegame in 5/5 bot games

skills.name: Opening principle: castle early
skills.summary: Castles within the first ~10 moves and connects rooks.
skills.masteryCriteria: Castles by move 10 in 8/10 games vs bot ~800

skills.name: Basic opening traps
skills.summary: Knows and avoids classic traps (Scholar's, Legal, Fried Liver, Noah's Ark).
skills.masteryCriteria: Avoids or exploits each of 6 classic traps in scripted bot games in 6/6

skills.name: Using a chess clock and time controls
skills.summary: Uses a clock correctly (same hand, increments, delay) and knows standard/rapid/blitz definitions.
skills.masteryCriteria: Plays 3 OTB or simulated games with clock with no procedural errors; scores >=90% on time-control quiz
references: FIDE Laws of Chess 2023 Art. 6, App. A.1, B.1

skills.name: Draw offers and claims
skills.summary: Offers draws correctly (after moving, before pressing the clock; cannot be withdrawn) and claims 3-fold/50-move draws by writing the intended move and calling the arbiter; knows incorrect-claim penalties.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores 100% on 12 draw-offer and claim-procedure items

skills.name: Illegal moves, irregularities and flag fall
skills.summary: Illegal-move procedure (+2 min, 1 min rapid/blitz, second illegal move loses) and flag-fall results including the "can the opponent mate?" rule (Art. 6.9).
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=90% on 20 irregularity and flag-fall items (e.g., K+N v K+R both ways)
references: FIDE Laws of Chess 2023 Art. 7.5, App. A.3

skills.name: Reading and writing FEN
skills.summary: Reads and writes all six FEN fields including castling rights, e.p. square and move counters.
skills.masteryCriteria: Converts 5 diagrams to FEN and 5 FENs to diagrams with 100% accuracy

skills.name: PGN game files
skills.summary: Understands PGN tags, movetext, comments, variations and NAGs; imports/exports games.
skills.masteryCriteria: Writes a valid PGN with the 7-tag roster, 1 variation and 2 comments that parses without error in the Lichess importer, in 2/2 attempts

skills.name: Keeping score in tournaments
skills.summary: Records moves on a scoresheet move by move, knows the under-5-minutes exemption and draw-offer marking.
skills.masteryCriteria: Keeps a complete correct scoresheet in 2 classical games (verified against PGN)

skills.name: Touch-move and adjusting pieces
skills.summary: Applies touch-move (first touched movable piece must move; touched enemy piece must be captured) and j'adoube.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores 100% on 12 touch-move scenario items

skills.name: Two-motif combinations
skills.summary: Combines two motifs (e.g., decoy + fork) in 2-3 move combinations.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 30 mixed short puzzles ~1400 with >=80% accuracy, median <90s
references: Yusupov's Chess School: Build Up Your Chess 1

skills.name: Decoy (attraction)
skills.summary: Lures a piece (often the king) onto a square where it can be forked, pinned or mated.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 attraction puzzles ~1400 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Deflection and overloading
skills.summary: Forces a defender away from its duty or exploits a defender with two duties.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 deflection puzzles ~1400 plus 10 curated overloading positions with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Discovered attacks
skills.summary: Moves a piece to unmask an attack from a line piece behind it.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 discoveredAttack puzzles ~1300 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Discovered check
skills.summary: Unmasks a check while the moving piece wins material; includes the windmill (repeated discovered checks).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 discoveredCheck puzzles ~1300 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Double check
skills.summary: Gives check with two pieces; only king moves answer it.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 15 doubleCheck puzzles ~1400 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Drawing tactics: perpetual check and stalemate tricks
skills.summary: Saves worse positions with unending checks or stalemate (desperado rook, queen sacrifice).
skills.masteryCriteria: Finds the save in 20 curated perpetual/stalemate positions with >=85% accuracy
references: Lichess has no perpetual theme: curated set

skills.name: Relative pins and exploiting pins
skills.summary: Pins to queen/rook/key squares; piles up on and attacks pinned pieces; knows pinned pieces don't defend.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 pin puzzles ~1400 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Removing the defender
skills.summary: Captures or exchanges the piece guarding a key square or piece.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 capturingDefender puzzles ~1400 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Trapping pieces
skills.summary: Attacks pieces with no safe squares (Bxa7 b6, knight on the rim, Noah's Ark).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 trappedPiece puzzles ~1400 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Anastasia's mate
skills.summary: Knight and rook/queen trap the king on the edge.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 12 anastasiaMate puzzles with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Epaulette, dovetail and swallow's tail mates
skills.summary: Queen mates kings whose flight squares are blocked by their own pieces.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 15 puzzles across epauletteMate, dovetailMate and swallowstailMate with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Boden's and double-bishop mates
skills.summary: Two bishops on criss-crossing diagonals mate.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 bodenMate/doubleBishopMate puzzles with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Hook and corner mates
skills.summary: Rook, knight and pawn mate with an enemy pawn blocking.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 16 hookMate/cornerMate puzzles with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Kill box, triangle and blind swine mates
skills.summary: Queen and rook coordinate in a 3x3 box or triangle.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 18 killBoxMate/triangleMate/blindSwineMate puzzles with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Queen-and-minor mates: Lolli, Greco, Balestra
skills.summary: Queen+pawn on g7 (Lolli) and queen+bishop on the h-file vs h8 (Greco).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 8 balestraMate puzzles and 10 curated Lolli/Greco puzzles with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Mate in three
skills.summary: Finds forcing three-move mates including sacrifices.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 mateIn3 puzzles ~1500 with >=80% accuracy, median <2 min

skills.name: Rook-and-bishop mates: Morphy, Pillsbury, Opera, Mayet
skills.summary: Rook and bishop coordinate: bishop mates with rook confining (Morphy), rook mates with bishop confining (Pillsbury), back-rank rook mates defended by a bishop (Opera, Mayet, Anderssen with pawn support).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 puzzles across morphysMate, pillsburysMate and operaMate plus 5 curated Mayet/Anderssen mates with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Candidate moves
skills.summary: Lists 2-4 candidate moves before calculating any deeply (Kotov).
skills.masteryCriteria: In 15 critical positions writes 2+ candidates that include the engine top move in >=80% of cases

skills.name: Calculating to a quiet position
skills.summary: Never stops calculating in the middle of an exchange or while checks/captures remain.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 15 exchange-sequence puzzles gives the correct material balance at the end with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Visualization: 2-4 plies
skills.summary: Holds a position in mind for 2-4 plies of described moves.
skills.masteryCriteria: After reading 4 plies from a diagram (no board update), answers 3 questions about the resulting position with >=90% accuracy across 15 items

skills.name: The centre
skills.summary: Classical vs hypermodern centre, open/closed/dynamic centres, and reacting in the centre to flank attacks.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=85% on a 15-item centre-concepts quiz with diagrams

skills.name: Evaluation elements and imbalances
skills.summary: Evaluates a position via material, king safety, activity, structure, space, imbalances.
skills.masteryCriteria: Writes a 5-element evaluation for 10 positions agreeing with coach/engine verdict in >=75%
references: Silman, How to Reassess Your Chess

skills.name: What to exchange
skills.summary: Trades when ahead, when cramped, bad-for-good pieces; avoids trades when attacking.
skills.masteryCriteria: Chooses the correct exchange decision in 15 positions with >=80% accuracy

skills.name: King safety
skills.summary: Keeps pawn cover intact, avoids weakening moves, uses luft wisely.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 15 positions identifies the safer king and the key weakness with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Open and half-open files
skills.summary: Puts rooks on open/half-open files, doubles, and fights for entry squares.
skills.masteryCriteria: Chooses correct rook placement in 15 diagrams with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Pawn islands and doubled pawns
skills.summary: Counts pawn islands and prefers fewer.
skills.masteryCriteria: Counts islands and picks the better structure in 15 diagrams and scores >=85% on 12 doubled-pawn items

skills.name: Isolated pawns and blockade
skills.summary: Knows weakness of isolated pawns and the blockade square.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=85% on a 12-item isolated-pawn quiz; wins 3/5 drill positions attacking an isolani

skills.name: Passed pawns and blockade
skills.summary: Creates, supports and pushes passed pawns; blockades enemy passers with pieces (ideally knights).
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=85% on 15 passed-pawn items; converts 3/4 passed-pawn middlegame positions vs bot

skills.name: King activity in the endgame
skills.summary: Centralises the king and uses it as a fighting piece once queens are off.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 10 simplified positions chooses an engine-top-3 king move in >=80%

skills.name: Pawn breakthroughs
skills.summary: Sacrifices pawns to create a queening passer (e.g., three v three b6!).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 12 breakthrough puzzles with >=85% accuracy
references: de la Villa, 100 Endgames You Must Know

skills.name: Key squares
skills.summary: Knows key squares for pawns on each rank and the rook-pawn exception.
skills.masteryCriteria: Marks key squares for 15 pawn placements with 100% accuracy; wins 5/5 key-square positions vs engine
references: de la Villa, 100 Endgames You Must Know

skills.name: Opposition (direct, distant, diagonal)
skills.summary: Takes the opposition to win or draw K+P v K and simple pawn endings.
skills.masteryCriteria: Achieves correct result in 10/10 opposition positions vs engine (both sides)

skills.name: Outside and protected passed pawns
skills.summary: Uses an outside passer as a decoy to win on the other wing.
skills.masteryCriteria: Wins 5/5 outside-passer and 4/5 protected-passer pawn endings vs engine

skills.name: Pawn races and tempo counting
skills.summary: Counts tempi in races including queening with check and skewers.
skills.masteryCriteria: Predicts the result of 15 pawn races with >=90% accuracy

skills.name: Queen vs pawn on the 7th
skills.summary: Wins vs central/knight pawns; knows rook/bishop pawn stalemate draws and the winning zone basics.
skills.masteryCriteria: Wins 5/5 Q v central/knight pawn and holds 3/3 Q v bishop/rook pawn draws vs engine
references: de la Villa, 100 Endgames You Must Know

skills.name: Rook vs pawn basics
skills.summary: Wins when the rook side's king is in front of the pawn or the defending king is cut off.
skills.masteryCriteria: Correct result in 8/10 basic R v P positions vs engine
references: de la Villa, 100 Endgames You Must Know

skills.name: Wrong-coloured bishop and rook pawn
skills.summary: Draws K v K+B+rook pawn when the bishop does not control the promotion square.
skills.masteryCriteria: Holds 5/5 wrong-bishop positions as defender and wins 5/5 right-bishop positions vs engine
references: de la Villa, 100 Endgames You Must Know

skills.name: Closed and Indian openings overview
skills.summary: Main ideas of QGD, Slav, QGA, London, KID, Nimzo, Grünfeld, Dutch, English.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=85% on a 20-item quiz identifying openings by position and naming one plan each

skills.name: Learning initiative with gambits
skills.summary: Plays Danish/Evans/Scotch gambits to learn development leads and initiative.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=60% in 10 gambit training games vs bot of equal rating

skills.name: Open games ideas (1.e4 e5)
skills.summary: Main ideas of Italian, Two Knights, Scotch, Ruy Lopez basics, Petrov, King's Gambit.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=85% on a 20-item open-games ideas quiz (plans, traps, typical pawn breaks)

skills.name: Complete basic repertoire
skills.summary: Has one White system and two Black defences, 8-10 moves deep, with typical plans.
skills.masteryCriteria: Opening-drill accuracy >=90% over the whole repertoire (8-10 moves) on two sessions 7 days apart

skills.name: Semi-open defences overview
skills.summary: Main ideas of Sicilian, French, Caro-Kann, Scandinavian, Pirc/Modern, Alekhine.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=85% on a 20-item quiz identifying openings by position and naming one plan each

skills.name: Opening traps by repertoire
skills.summary: Knows the traps in own repertoire lines (Elephant, Lasker, Siberian, Mortimer, etc.).
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 opening-phase puzzles ~1300 with >=85% accuracy

skills.name: Over-the-board etiquette, conduct and fair play
skills.summary: Handles OTB procedures and conduct rules: arriving before default time, scoresheet, claims, electronic devices, no distraction.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores 100% on 15 OTB procedure and conduct scenario items

skills.name: Post-game review habit
skills.summary: Reviews own games first without engine, then with engine, logging mistakes.
skills.masteryCriteria: Submits 10 reviewed games with own annotations at 3+ critical moments each

skills.name: Time budgeting
skills.summary: Distributes thinking time across the game; avoids flagging.
skills.masteryCriteria: In 10 rated 15+10 games: no flag losses and never under 1 min before move 30

skills.name: Rapid, blitz and quickplay regulations
skills.summary: Applies Appendix A/B differences (no scoresheet, 1-minute penalties, supervision conditions) and online rule differences.
skills.masteryCriteria: Scores >=90% on 12 rapid/blitz scenario items
references: FIDE Laws of Chess 2023 Art. App. A, B

skills.name: Clearance and line opening
skills.summary: Vacates a square or line for another piece; sacrifices to open lines toward the king.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 15 clearance puzzles ~1700 and 8 curated line-opening positions with >=80% accuracy

skills.name: Defensive tactics
skills.summary: Finds defensive moves: counter-threats, interposition with tempo, giving back material.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 20 defensiveMove puzzles ~1700 with >=75% accuracy

skills.name: Desperado
skills.summary: A doomed piece sells itself for maximum material.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 12 curated desperado positions with >=80% accuracy

skills.name: Endgame tactics
skills.summary: Breakthroughs, deflection of blockaders, skewers of promoted queens, knight forks in endings.
skills.masteryCriteria: Solves 25 endgame-phase puzzles ~1700 with >=80% accuracy

skills.name: Greek gift sacrifice Bxh7+
skills.summary: Executes Bxh7+ Kxh7 Ng5+ with Qh5 and knows the preconditions and king-retreat lines.
